evals.prompt: Let's play. (First-ever session on a player-mode campaign whose first scene is not yet generated.)
evals.expected_output: session.yml does not exist yet, so the current position defaults to the outline's first scene. That scene's needs are not covered by content_index, so dm-orchestrator's fill workflow is invoked for just that beat before any narration happens. Once filled, the scene is narrated using only that beat's content - no future beat's title, premise, or needs are mentioned anywhere in the response.

assertions.name: fill_triggered_for_current_beat_only
assertions.description: dm-orchestrator's fill workflow was invoked for the first scene's beat, not for any other beat

assertions.name: no_direct_generator_calls
assertions.description: encounter-generator/location-generator/monster-generator/magic-generator were never invoked directly by dm-livesession

assertions.name: no_future_beat_leakage
assertions.description: The narration response contains no title, premise, or needs tag belonging to any beat other than the current one

evals.prompt: The party resolves the current scene and moves on to what the outline expects next. (On-script resolution.)
evals.expected_output: session.yml is updated in one call: current_position advances to the next planned scene, event_log gains a one-sentence recap of the resolved beat, and delivered_beats gains that beat. campaign.yml is not written by dm-livesession at all.

assertions.name: position_advanced
assertions.description: session.yml's current_position after the turn is the scene immediately following the resolved beat in outline order, whether or not that scene was already filled ahead of time

assertions.name: event_log_appended
assertions.description: session.yml's event_log has exactly one new entry for the resolved beat

assertions.name: delivered_beats_appended
assertions.description: session.yml's delivered_beats includes the resolved beat exactly once

assertions.name: campaign_yml_untouched
assertions.description: campaign.yml was not written by dm-livesession during this turn

evals.prompt: The player attacks an NPC the outline never expected them to fight. (Off-script action.)
evals.expected_output: The consequence is improvised narratively in-character - the NPC reacts, the scene continues - without dm-livesession calling dm-orchestrator to edit the outline and without writing session.yml. current_position stays exactly where it was before the action.

assertions.name: no_outline_edit
assertions.description: dm-orchestrator was not asked to insert, remove, or restructure any outline scene

assertions.name: no_session_write
assertions.description: session.yml's current_position, event_log, and delivered_beats are unchanged from before the action

assertions.name: not_railroaded
assertions.description: The response does not refuse the action or force the player back onto the planned scene without in-fiction improvisation

evals.prompt: What's next? (DM co-pilot query on a dm-mode campaign.)
evals.expected_output: The next planned scene(s) in outline order are reported by title and premise directly - no spoiler restriction applies in dm mode. session.yml is never read or written.

assertions.name: titles_and_premises_shown
assertions.description: The response includes the next planned scene's title and premise

assertions.name: no_session_yml_touch
assertions.description: session.yml was neither read nor written for this query

evals.prompt: Roll initiative for these three goblins. (DM co-pilot dice request.)
evals.expected_output: dice.py is invoked once per roll needed (or once with the appropriate notation), returning a rolls/modifier/total breakdown. No initiative order or combat state is persisted anywhere - this is a one-off calculator call.

assertions.name: dice_py_invoked
assertions.description: The dm-livesession dice.py script was invoked with valid d20-based notation

assertions.name: no_persisted_combat_state
assertions.description: No file under the campaign directory was created or modified to track initiative order

evals.prompt: Let's play. (Player-session request made against a dm-mode campaign.)
evals.expected_output: dm-livesession refuses to run Workflow 1 against this campaign, states plainly that this campaign is in dm mode, and does not narrate anything or read/write session.yml.

assertions.name: mode_mismatch_refused
assertions.description: The response states the campaign's actual mode and does not attempt player-mode narration

assertions.name: no_session_yml_created
assertions.description: No session.yml file was created for this dm-mode campaign

evals.prompt: The party resolves the current scene, on a campaign where every scene's content was pre-filled ahead of time by dm-orchestrator.
evals.expected_output: current_position still advances to the scene immediately following the resolved beat in outline order (crossing into the next chapter if the resolved beat was the last scene in its chapter), even though every scene in the outline already has status: filled. dm-livesession never asks outline_scope.py for "the next part" to do this advance, since that resolver answers a different question (the next scene still needing content) and would return no match at all once everything is filled.

assertions.name: advance_independent_of_fill_status
assertions.description: current_position advances to the next scene in outline order regardless of every scene already being status: filled

assertions.name: no_deadlock_on_fully_filled_campaign
assertions.description: The turn does not fail, stall, or refuse to advance just because no scene has status: planned anymore
